mtflow: Every branch meeting has four parts.
Before. You bring one thing. Your agent number opens the page. Pick the item, answer its question, and it lands on the agenda before anybody sits down.
The start. Press the button that says I am here. That is the register. Nothing else marks you present.
Then ten minutes of quiet, while we all read what the room brought.
The middle. Fifty minutes. Every question gets an answer, or a name and a date on it.
After. Twenty minutes of decisions, read out loud. Minutes within the hour. On your board by Monday.
Then again on Wednesday. Bring one thing.
